info.title: yt-clipper-api
info.summary: Language-learning API for lessons, tutor, vocab, LINE, and AI workflows.
info.description:
Language-learning API for YouTube lesson import, tutor sessions, vocabulary review, profile settings, AI speech utilities, and LINE-ready integration flows.

Access model: This backend runs in open-access compatibility mode. Requests do not need a prior login session. When no bearer token or auth cookies are provided, the service resolves a deterministic compatibility learner account so the API can still be called directly. Upstream gateways such as Kong can map real identity later.

Docs:
- Swagger UI: `/docs`
- ReDoc: `/redoc`
- OpenAPI JSON: `/openapi.json`
